answer_1.quote: The perturber takes in (i) a source text snippet, (ii) a word in the snippet referring to a demographic group, and (iii) a new target demographic attribute, and generates a perturbed snippet that refers to the target demographic attribute, while preserving overall meaning.

answer_2.quote: We achieve a BLEU score of 88.0 (measured against the source) on the validation set, and perplexity of 1.06... The perturber generations show higher BLEU and ROUGE scores than do AugLy and TextFlint, as well as lower Levenshtein distance.

answer_4.quote: The perturber outputs are annotated by 2 expert annotators; each example was annotated by both experts to calculate interannotator agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated perturbed outputs using predefined error categories such as factuality change, incomplete/incorrect perturbation, stage 1 errors, typos and naturalness, and incorrectly unperturbed.
